The resulting model of discrete gravity is demonstrated to preserve local Lorentz invariance and symplectic structure. arxiv-2301-00132.title: Relationships between two linearizations of the box-ball system : Kerov-Kirillov-Reschetikhin bijection and slot configuration
arxiv-2301-00132.creator: Matteo Mucciconi, Makiko Sasada, Tomohiro Sasamoto and Hayate Suda
arxiv-2301-00132.description: Abstract . The box-ball system (BBS), which was introduced by Takahashi and Satsuma in 1990, is a soliton cellular automaton. Its dynamics can be linearized by a few methods, among which the best known is the Kerov-Kirillov-Reschetikhin (KKR) bijection using rigged partitions.

arxiv-2302-06656.title: Enhancing User Personalization in Conversational Recommenders Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023; May 1–5, 2023; Austin, TX, USA Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023 (WWW ’23), May 1–5, 2023, Austin, TX, USA Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3543507.3583192 ISBN: 978-1-4503-9416-1/
arxiv-2302-06656.creator: Allen Lin, Ziwei Zhu, Jianling Wang, James Caverlee
arxiv-2302-06656.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Allen Lin, Ziwei Zhu, Jianling Wang, James Caverlee. Conversational recommenders are emerging as a powerful tool to personalize a user’s recommendation experience. Through a back-and-forth dialogue, users can quickly hone in on just the right items. Many approaches to conversational recommendation, however, only partially explore the user preference space and make limiting assumptions about how user feedback can be best incorporated, resulting in long dialogues and poor recommendation performance.

arxiv-2303-05560.title: Applications of Machine Learning to Detecting Fast Neutrino Flavor Instabilities in Core-Collapse Supernova and Neutron Star Merger Models
arxiv-2303-05560.creator: Sajad Abbar Max-Planck-Institut für Physik (Werner-Heisenberg-Institut), Föhringer Ring 6, 80805 München, Germany
arxiv-2303-05560.description: Abstract Neutrinos propagating in a dense neutrino gas, such as those expected in core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) and neutron star mergers (NSMs), can experience fast flavor conversions on relatively short scales. This can happen if the neutrino electron lepton number ( ν \nu ELN) angular distribution crosses zero in a certain direction.

arxiv-2410-08339.title: Simultaneous Weight and Architecture Optimization for Neural Networks
arxiv-2410-08339.creator: Zitong Huang, Mansooreh Montazerin, Ajitesh Srivastava
arxiv-2410-08339.description: Abstract Neural networks are trained by choosing an architecture and training the parameters. The choice of architecture is often by trial and error or with Neural Architecture Search (NAS) methods. While NAS provides some automation, it often relies on discrete steps that optimize the architecture and then train the parameters.

arxiv-2412-09697.title: A Randomization-Based Method for Evaluating Time-Varying Treatment Effects Thanks: Corresponding author: Kwonsang Lee (kwonsanglee@snu.ac.kr)
arxiv-2412-09697.creator: Sangjin Lee, Department of Statistics, Seoul National University, Republic of Korea
arxiv-2412-09697.description: Abstract Tests for paired censored outcomes have been extensively studied, with some justified in the context of randomization-based inference. These tests are primarily designed to detect an overall treatment effect across the entire follow-up period, providing limited insight into when the effect manifests and how it changes over time.

pmc-10582966.creator: Qian Wu, Rui Han, Zhen Li, Xiaojun Huang, Di Cheng, Jiacheng Ni, Shizhe Zhang, Xunan Tan, Piao Kang, Shujie Yu, Anran Chen, Yuwei Lu, Fangshu Yao, Zihao Jin, Yiming Qin, Jingyi Guo, Dan Liu, Ying Zhang, Yanxia Song, Liping Zhu, Qin Lu, Qiandi Chen, Chengxiang Lin, Qichen Fang, Maituersong Maimaitika
pmc-10582966.description: IntroductionObesity is a complex and multifactorial disease that has affected many adolescents in recent decades. Clinical practice guidelines recommend exercise as the key treatment option for adolescents with overweight and obesity. However, the effects of virtual reality (VR) exercise on the physical and brain health of adolescents with overweight and obese remain unclear.

pmc-11352854.title: Protective Role of Astaxanthin in Regulating Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Inflammation and Apoptosis in Human Neutrophils
pmc-11352854.creator: Seongheon Lee, Sung Kuk Son, Eunye Cho, Sungah Yoo, Eun-A Jang, Sang Hyun Kwak, Madhav Bhatia, Chan-Yen Kuo
pmc-11352854.description: Astaxanthin, a keto-carotenoid, is known to have potent antioxidant properties. This study aims to investigate the anti-inflammatory effect of astaxanthin and its mechanism in human neutrophils. The effects of astaxanthin on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated human neutrophils were investigated in vitro. Neutrophils were isolated from healthy volunteers and stimulated with LPS in the presence and absence of astaxanthin.

pmc-12373522.title: Efficacy of combination chelation with deferasirox and deferiprone in children with beta-thalassemia major: an audit from a unit in the developing world
pmc-12373522.creator: Vinson James, Anand Prakash
pmc-12373522.description: Effective iron chelation is crucial for preventing morbidity and mortality in transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia major. While oral chelation is the preferred mode of administration, heavily iron-overloaded patients often require combination therapy. Although desferoxamine and deferiprone are commonly recommended, a combination of two oral chelators—deferasirox and deferiprone, offers a more convenient alternative.

pmc-12594884.description: The green synthesis of iron nanoparticles (FeNPs) using plant extracts has attracted considerable attention because of their potential to effectively decolorize dye-containing wastewater. pmc-13246160.title: Organic components modulate the morphology of respirable aerovirology-relevant aerosols
pmc-13246160.creator: Deepak Sapkota, Yuhui Guo, Amrita Chakraborty, James Hu, Harris Xie, Ian Wu, Moon J Kim, Hui Ouyang
pmc-13246160.description: Airborne transmission of viruses occurs via aerosol particles, whose morphology provides insights into the microenvironments that viruses experience. Aerosol morphology includes particle size, shape, phase state, and chemical homogeneity, yet systematic studies remain limited. Here, we characterized model bioaerosol morphologies generated from (1) NaCl–organic two-component mixtures, (2) common cell culture media, and (3) artificial respiratory fluids.

pmc-13570928.title: Anatomy of Cerebro-cerebellar Circuits in Motor Control
pmc-13570928.creator: Tom JH Ruigrok, Zhenyu Gao
pmc-13570928.description: Cerebral cortex and cerebellum are intimately connected enabling them to perform their functions in learning, controlling and executing our daily movements. This review aims to provide a summary of both the cortico-cerebellar as well as of the cerebello-cortical routes that are used in their interaction. As such, this review will mostly concentrate on connections that are involved in motor control.

pmc-13646397.creator: Noah Münster, Ulrike Felt
pmc-13646397.description: How do emerging environmental phenomena become actionable amid scientific uncertainty and public urgency? This article argues that to understand how microplastics become governable, we must study classification as a central site where matters of fact, concern, and care are composed.
